inv.desc_es:
Mare de Deu del Coll - Baixada de la Gloria - Passatge Espíria

Este local con entrada tanto por Mare de Deu del Coll como por Passatge Espíria, está ubicado en una excelente posición. Se trata de tres unidades registrales que actualmente están unidas, distirbuidas en 3 plantas. Es amplio y versátil para diferentes tipos de negocios.

Características del local:

- Dos baños y un aseo (uno por planta).
- Servicio de luz y agua dados de alta.

Consta de una superficie de 360 m2.

Una excelente oportunidad por su ubicación estratégica y las características que ofrece. ¡Ven a verlo sin compromiso!

Llámanos para coordinar una visita a tu gusto.

Nuestro horario de atención telefónica es:
- De lunes a jueves de 9:30 a 14:00 y de 15:30 a 19:30

Si no nos encuentras en el teléfono, envíanos una solicitud de información y te llamaremos a la mayor brevedad.

inv.desc_en:
Mare de Deu del Coll - Baixada de la Gloria - Passatge Espíria

This premises, with entrances from both Mare de Deu del Coll and Passatge Espíria, is located in an excellent position. It consists of three registered units that are currently joined, distributed over 3 floors. It is spacious and versatile for different types of businesses.

Features of the premises:

- Two bathrooms and one restroom (one per floor).
- Electricity and water services connected.

It has a surface area of 360 m2.

An excellent opportunity due to its strategic location and the features it offers. Come see it without obligation!

Call us to arrange a visit at your convenience.

Our telephone customer service hours are:
- Monday to Thursday from 9:30 to 14:00 and from 15:30 to 19:30
- And Friday from 9:30 to 14:00
If you cannot reach us by phone, send us an information request and we will call you as soon as possible.

Peraire Properties S. L. acts as a qualified and registered professional, and has guarantee and civil liability insurance to protect the consumer:
- AICAT (Real Estate Agent of Catalonia): 8920
- API Member (Real Estate Property Agent): A11748

As a consumer, we recommend that you always demand that your intermediary complies with current obligations, guarantees, and regulations.

At Peraire, you will find a close, ethical, and transparent real estate brokerage service.
We work for you. Our goal is to achieve your objectives, represent you, and protect you legally.

We are driven only by your success.
